title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 10 review
subtitle: The home, in / on and place phrases (Unit 10)

words.def: the room where you sleep
words.sent: My bed is in the ___.

words.def: the room with a shower or a bath
words.sent: The shower is in the ___.

words.def: the room where you cook
words.sent: Mum is cooking dinner in the ___.

words.def: the room with the sofa and the TV
words.sent: We watch TV on the sofa in the ___.

words.def: the room with a big table where you eat meals
words.sent: We eat dinner at the big table in the ___.

words.def: the place outside your house with grass and flowers
words.sent: The children are playing outside in the ___.

words.def: you open it to go into a room
words.sent: Please close the ___ when you go out.

words.def: glass in a wall; you look out of it
words.sent: It’s hot. Can you open the ___?

words.def: the part of a room you walk on
words.sent: There’s a red carpet on the ___.

words.def: the side of a room; you put pictures on it
words.sent: There’s a picture on the ___.

words.def: lying down to sleep
words.sent: It’s 11 p.m. — the children are ___.

words.def: inside a car you pay a driver to take you in
words.sent: I’m ___ — the driver is taking me to the hotel.

words.def: travelling on a vehicle on a railway
words.sent: I’m ___ to Manchester.

words.def: flying in the sky
words.sent: We’re ___ to Tokyo — in the sky now.

words.def: not working; travelling to have fun
words.sent: I’m not at work — I’m ___ in Spain.

words.def: at the place where you do your job
words.sent: I’m ___ — I’m in a meeting.

words.def: where planes take off and land
words.sent: My plane leaves in an hour. I’m ___ now.

words.def: where you wait for a bus
words.sent: I’m waiting for the number 12 ___.

words.def: at an event with music and friends
words.sent: It’s my friend’s birthday. I’m ___.

words.def: where you drink coffee out of the house
words.sent: I’m having a cappuccino ___.
